title: Tracking Outcomes in Patients With Chronic Pain Prescribed Intravenous Lidocaine
official: Tracking Outcomes by Secondary Diagnoses in Patients Prescribed Intravenous Lidocaine for Chronic Pain
summary: The purpose of this research is to gather data on the performance and functionality of IV lidocaine infusions prescribed to patients with chronic pain.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-80 years
* Patients with chronic pain syndrome
* Patients that have been prescribed and scheduled to receive an intravenous lidocaine infusion treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not willing to comply with the requirements of the study
sponsor: International Spine, Pain and Performance Center
